utterances.text: Before we start, can we agree on what this demonstration must prove?
Yes. We need clear speaker identities, reliable timing, and a mixture we can reproduce.
I also want every intermediate file kept, so a bad result can be traced.
That makes sense. I will keep the clean utterances and the per-speaker tracks.
How long should the first recording be?
Around forty seconds is enough for a clean baseline.
Good. No overlap and no noise in this one.
Then we can compare it with the crowded versions without changing the transcript.
Exactly. Let us run the checks before we call it complete.
Agreed. I will verify duration, clipping, labels, and the exported manifest.
